title: Beautiful!
text: Beautiful!. My daughter is away at college and needed some decor on her walls. She's a wildlife/nature lover and is thrilled with these prints! They have a vintage look to them, which is something she likes. The prints are well done. They're not on paper, but on linen which adds to the vintage look. These look very nice on her living room wall.
